item.title: La Jornada Filipina in English | News from the Philippines, society, and politics
item.description: After five years, La Jornada Filipina ceased operations on March 14, 2026. La Jornada Filipina started off as a platform to cover stories about the Philippines and its connection to the Spanish-speaking world, to unearth narratives that traditional media never covers, and to provide a home for the forgotten Spanish legacy.
